title: MinosEval: Distinguishing Factoid and Non-Factoid for Tailored Open-Ended QA Evaluation with LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of distinguishing factoid and non-factoid questions to improve the evaluation of LLMs in open-ended question answering. It contains a standard 'Ethical Considerations' section regarding data privacy and participation, but it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as part of its research goals.
